text: 中国央行发布2026年二季度金融机构贷款投向统计报告。报告提到，2026年二季度末，人民币房地产贷款余额50.74万亿元，同比下降4.9%，上半年减少1.23万亿元。
text_en: The PBOC released the Q2 2026 financial institution loan allocation report. The report noted that at the end of Q2 2026, RMB real estate loans totaled 50.74 trillion yuan, down 4.9% year-on-year, with a decrease of 1.23 trillion yuan in H1.
